title: Service-token claims (v1alpha1)
description: Claims of the kernel-issued service token that proves which plugin is calling and what it may do. Carried in the JSON body of a compact 'v1.<base64url(claims)>.<base64url(ed25519sig)>' token. The plugin half of the double-token intersection.

aud.description: Audience: the kernel verifies this token on the return path.

exp.description: Expiry, unix seconds (short TTL; refreshed while running).

scopes.description: The plugin's approved scopes (manifest capabilities/permissions ∩ operator approval). Authoritative for the plugin half of the intersection.
